name: Action
description: The primary action a creature takes on its turn — Attack, Cast a Spell, Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Help, Hide, Ready, Search, or Use an Object.

name: Bonus Action
description: A faster supplementary action granted by specific class features, spells, or feats.

name: Reaction
description: An instant response triggered by a specific event — opportunity attacks, the Shield spell, the Cutting Words feature.

name: Free Action
description: Called the Object Interaction in 5.1 and Free in 2024 — interact with one nearby object as part of your turn at no cost.

name: Magic Action
description: 2024-only: a unified Action used to cast a spell or activate a magic effect (replaces Cast a Spell as a distinct Action type).

name: Ritual
description: Casts a spell with the Ritual tag in +10 minutes without expending a spell slot.
